research_question: Can the exact ground state used by the finite-time PF calibration be replaced by RHF or CISD states while preserving PF feasibility, QPE cost prediction, and PF ranking?

exact_ground_state_allowed_for: oracle reference data already recorded in the source artifact
post hoc state overlap and error evaluation
direct validation at newly required absolute times
information_access.oracle_analytic_time_use: The source run's analytic time fixes the query locations in this H01 controlled diagnostic. End-to-end cheap determination of alpha and the time scale is deferred to H05.

state_methods.frozen_core_and_orbital_space: must exactly match the Hamiltonian condition

proxy.echo_amplitude: z_echo(t)=<phi|exp(-i H t) U_PF(t)|phi>, using the sign convention of the source runner
proxy.phase_unwrap: start at the smallest positive time and choose the continuous phase branch

calibration.time_scale: reuse each source PF/Hamiltonian analytic_time only to isolate state substitution
calibration.fit: unweighted signed least squares with fixed powers [4,6]

direct_validation.fine_candidate_rule: same fixed rule as the source hold-out: all four pass, one near-threshold failure, or a conclusion-changing isolated minimum
direct_validation.new_direct_points: compute only absolute times not already present in source raw/fine data and only when needed for the fixed proxy-model assessment
direct_validation.branch_rule: track the eigenbranch continuously from sufficiently small time; compare against maximum exact-ground overlap and flag any disagreement
direct_validation.primary_minimum: minimum over directly calculated grid points, not a continuous-time minimum

primary_success.unit: one fixed state method, PF, proxy definition, point count, and four-condition active-space set
primary_success.exact_ground_echo_sanity: echo_phase_5point must reproduce the source oracle conclusion or the proxy definition is rejected before interpreting approximate states
primary_success.cisd_transfer: CISD echo_phase_5point passes all four primary conditions and the 1.01 frozen budget in all four
primary_success.rhf_transfer: reported with the same criteria but not required for CISD success
primary_success.pf_selection: among proxy-feasible PFs, the proxy must identify the same lowest-direct-cost PF as the exact source result
primary_success.auxiliary_hf: reported separately; it cannot change the primary active-space success decision

comparison_outputs: proxy a4 and a6 versus direct-fit a4 and a6
proxy t_star versus oracle-model and direct-grid times
frozen-budget target achievement at multipliers 1.0 and 1.01
PF feasibility and lowest-cost PF selection
classical calibration time and memory including state preparation and exact-reference evolution

allowed: reuse source raw truth and server-local Hamiltonian caches after hash validation
rebuild caches when hashes or required fields are absent
compute only missing direct truth points required by the fixed validation grids
compare CPU and GPU implementations in a representative pilot
forbidden: add model powers or rational models
tune time points, thresholds, or safety margin after seeing results
perform F01, F02, F05, H02, H03, H04, H05, or new PF searches
